description: Source code for the Bitmap class managing a bit array, including bit manipulation methods such as set, get, toggle, resize, and range testing within the disk cache component.

classes.name: Bitmap
classes.description: A class representing a bitmap with methods for bit manipulation, resizing, and range testing.

methods.name: FindLSBNonEmpty
methods.description: Finds the index of the least significant bit set to |value| in a 32-bit word.

methods.name: Bitmap::Resize
methods.description: Resizes the bitmap to a new number of bits, optionally clearing new bits.

methods.name: Bitmap::Set
methods.description: Sets the bit at a specified index to true or false.

methods.name: Bitmap::Get
methods.description: Returns the value of the bit at a specified index.

methods.name: Bitmap::Toggle
methods.description: Toggles the bit at a specified index.

methods.name: Bitmap::SetMapElement
methods.description: Sets a specific element of the internal map.

methods.name: Bitmap::GetMapElement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific element of the internal map.

methods.name: Bitmap::SetMap
methods.description: Copies an external map into the internal map.

methods.name: Bitmap::SetRange
methods.description: Sets a range of bits to a specified value.

methods.name: Bitmap::TestRange
methods.description: Tests if any bit in a range matches a specified value.

methods.name: Bitmap::FindNextBit
methods.description: Finds the next bit set to a specified value starting from an index.

methods.name: Bitmap::FindBits
methods.description: Finds a contiguous run of bits with the same value starting from an index.

methods.name: Bitmap::SetWordBits
methods.description: Sets bits within a word to a specified value.
